elements.element: Vendor must defend Customer and its affiliates against covered claims.
elements.evidence: HDI must “defend ... the Company and its affiliates” against the specified claims.

elements.element: Vendor must indemnify Customer and its affiliates against covered claims and resulting losses.
elements.evidence: HDI must “indemnify the Company and its affiliates” from third-party claims and resulting damages, costs, expenses, and reasonable attorneys’ fees.

elements.element: The indemnity must apply to third-party claims.
elements.evidence: The introductory language expressly applies to “any third-party claim.”

elements.element: Coverage must include claims alleging that the services or deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Clause (1) covers allegations that the Services or HDI-provided deliverables, including the Site, “infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right.”

elements.element: Coverage must include third-party claims arising from Vendor's breach of law.
elements.evidence: Clause (2) covers claims arising from “HDI's breach of applicable law.”

elements.element: Coverage must include third-party claims arising from a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Clause (3) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company data caused by HDI, which operatively covers an HDI-caused data breach.

elements.element: Coverage must include third-party claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Clause (4) expressly covers “HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.”

elements.element: The indemnification procedure must require Customer to give Vendor notice of the claim.
elements.evidence: The Company must give HDI “prompt written notice of the claim.”

elements.element: The indemnification procedure must give Vendor control of the defense.
elements.evidence: The clause states that “HDI shall have control of the defense.”

elements.element: The indemnification procedure must require Customer to provide reasonable cooperation.
elements.evidence: The Company must “provide reasonable cooperation.”

elements.element: Any Customer indemnity must be limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
elements.evidence: The rendered operative language imposes no indemnity obligation on the Company. Accordingly, there is no Customer indemnity extending beyond the permitted subjects.

elements.element: Vendor must indemnify Customer against third-party IP infringement claims relating to the services or deliverables.
elements.evidence: HDI indemnifies the Company against third-party claims alleging that the Services or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.

elements.element: The IP indemnity must exclude claims caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No exclusion for modifications made by the Company appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: The IP indemnity must exclude claims caused by combinations with items not supplied or approved by Vendor.
elements.evidence: No combination exclusion appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: The IP indemnity must exclude claims arising from compliance with Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No exclusion for Company-provided specifications appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: The IP infringement remedies must allow Vendor to procure the right for Customer to continue using the affected services or deliverables.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no right-to-use procurement remedy.

elements.element: The IP infringement remedies must allow Vendor to modify the affected services or deliverables to make them non-infringing.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no modification remedy.

elements.element: The IP infringement remedies must allow Vendor to replace the affected services or deliverables with non-infringing substitutes.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no replacement remedy.

elements.element: The IP infringement remedies must provide a refund if the other infringement remedies are unavailable or unsuccessful.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no refund remedy.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnity liability must be subject to a super-cap equal to 3× annual fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no liability cap or reference to a cap of three times annual fees.

result.reason: The redline leaves the existing Globix provision unchanged and adds only a targeted HDI indemnity. It satisfies the preferred position through defense and indemnification for the specified third-party claim categories, the required notice/control/cooperation procedure, and no Company indemnity broader than the permitted scope. It does not satisfy the fallback because it omits the usual IP exclusions, infringement remedies, and 3× annual-fees super-cap.
